notes.title: A fiery landscape to warm the winter nights
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26089986/4f243b4c6843ac005e8895654cf699b874f37786.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26089986/87499aa8f58735a39b86c411c9a1930bac129312.jpg[/img][/url]
October tweaks...
* A new level (from the beta branch)
* Mist and god rays
* New skys
* Hard/Easy setting to tame the beasts
* Stars to collect in Hard mode to track your progress
* Leafy trees, pollen particles, and a flying contraption buzzing around and other additions to existing levels

notes.title: First major update is complete!
notes.content:
The first collection of updates since the game launched in August are done. 

New stuff:
There are now two movement styles, teleport and slide.
There is an enclosed escape room style level.
A machine has been added to skip to any level you have already visited.
Teleports are now powered by crystals which you must collect to progress.
The teleports which have been opened are saved.
Laser beams have been added.
Your progress is shown in the first 'Lobby' level.
Most levels have grown and had new challenges added.
The game is less linear, with some levels having a choice of teleports to open next.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26089986/14a1740b0962cb06f027866e15be37b8cd59edb7.jpg[/img]
